The '''''Rail''-class Advanced Recon Commando''' was a post-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] generation of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] [[Anti-trooper|troopers]] that was secretly bred by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] scientists in a plot to liberate [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Unlike the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] that served in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] before becoming [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]], the Rail-class ARC troopers were trained to have absolute loyalty to their Kaminoan creators instead of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Created to compliment Kamino's army of [[Anti-trooper|Anti-Imperial clone troopers]] as an elite force, the ARCs were stationed within the [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City Cloning Facility]] to protect the Kaminoans' precious batches of young clones that were still being developed to fight the Empire.

When the Empire learned of Kamino's plans for insurrection, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] dispatched a special detachment of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], under the command of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to Kamino with orders to annihilate the entire army of rebel clones. Thus, the Rail-class ARC troopers made their first and last stand alongside the Anti-troopers at the [[Kamino uprising]] in the year [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]].

==History==
===Kamino's Secret Clone Army===
{{Quote|So Palpatine has a new army. I have no doubt he'll find our cloning operations a threat one day very soon, and seek to destroy our capabilities. But he's a fool if he believes we handed over all of the combat-trained Fett clones to him.|Lama Su, Kaminoan prime minister, on discovering Palpatine's new Imperial Army.|<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
Following the rise of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor of]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], he quickly consolidated his [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with an iron fist. Paving the way for Imperial rule were the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]], [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the late [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] that served as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] prior to the Emperor's ascendancy to absolute power. It was then that the Kaminoans found their homeworld placed under Imperial occupation by their own creations, no less.<ref name="SWIII">{{Film|III}}</ref><ref name="BattlefrontII" />

Having made the mistake of indoctrinating the original Fett clones with absolute loyalty to the Republic, and thus the Empire, the Kaminoans sought to rectify their error by discreetly breeding a new clone army that was completely obedient to their Kaminoan creators. While the majority of the army was composed of [[Anti-trooper]]s, a special force of elite soldiers were created to compliment the regular soldiers. Hence, the Kaminoans engineered a new generation of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]]&mdash;the ''Rail''-class ARC troopers. Under the observation of the Kaminoans, the Rail-class ARCs and the rest of the rebel clones were grown and trained for nearly a decade.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

The Rail-class ARC troopers were equipped with the [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|ARC-variant]] [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I armor]], which included the [[Pauldron/Legends|command pauldrons]] and [[Kama/Legends|kamas]]. Their primary weapon was the [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|chainguns]].<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

===The Uprising on Kamino===
{{Quote|Officially, there never was a 'clone rebellion' on Kamino. Unofficially, approximately twenty years after we were created, a special detachment of the Imperial 501st Legion was dispatched to Kamino, with orders to eradicate an army of clones that had been bred to take arms against the Empire.|Anonymous 501st stormtrooper|<ref name="BattlefrontII" />}}
Approximately twenty years after the Kaminoans created the first [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] for the Republic, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] sent the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to destroy the rebel clones and bring Kamino back into line. The 501st's mission commander was the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who also happened to be a clone of Jango Fett. While the Anti-troopers defended Tipoca City's outer perimeter, the Rail-class ARC troopers remained within the cloning facility to protect the batches of undeveloped rebel clones.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

[[File:BF2_Kamino_4.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Rail-class ARC trooper attacks Imperial stormtroopers during the [[Kamino uprising]].]]

Despite their fast growth and training, the Anti-troopers proved to be no match against Fett and the battle-hardened stormtroopers of the 501st Legion, many of whom were veterans of the Clone Wars. After storming the facility, Fett and his stormtroopers were suddenly engaged by the Rail-class ARC troopers, some of whom tried to take the fight outside and prevent the Imperials from breaching the Tipoca City. Their efforts failed, however, and the life support systems were destroyed, thus aborting the unborn Anti-troopers before they had a chance to fight. With the rebel Kaminoans' capabilities to defend the city or grow another clone army severely diminished, they opted to escape from Kamino before the battle was completely lost.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

In the meantime, the last of the Rail-class ARC troopers joined the remaining Anti-troopers as they desperately fought against their relentless Imperial clone brethren. Though they battled hard, Fett and the 501st stormtroopers succeeded in crowding the rebel clones out onto the platforms where they were exterminated to the last clone. With the death of the Kaminoan insurgents that bred the rebel clone army, the Rail-class ARC troopers perished along with the Anti-troopers and the "''clone rebellion''" not only ended in failure, but would never be publicly known since all information regarding the Kamino Uprising became highly classified.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rail-class ARC troopers could be identified if a player targeted one of the chain-gun wielding troopers on ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' during the level "Kamino: Changing of the Guard", an 'unofficial' clone revolution.
